name: Combobox
summary: Select with search and a visual per option (flag, avatar or icon). Typing filters the list, arrows and Enter choose. Country select is the Combobox with flags and all countries as a ready-made preset.
use: Long lists the user wants to search in, like countries or organisations.
Options that need a visual to recognise them faster.
Country choice: use CountrySelect (country of residence, nationality, country of an address).
avoid: Short lists without a visual: use Select (native), it works better on mobile. A Select can also show a flag for the chosen country.
Free input that is not in the list: this component only accepts options from the list.
Choosing a language with flags only: a flag is a country, not a language. Always add the language name.
anatomy: Label, hint and error message (like Input).
Field with the visual of the chosen option, text and a chevron.
Listbox with optional group headings and options (visual, label, check mark on the chosen option).
Country select: Flag (3:2) as the visual, group Popular and All countries (alphabetical).
figmaProps: The example in Figma is a Country select.
Active = highlighted with keyboard or mouse.
_Combobox option: Label / Leading / Show leading / Selected
Leading swaps to a Flag/XX, Avatar or Icon. Flags are preferred values in the swap.
40 flags: EU27, GB, US, CA, AU, CH, NO, IS, TR, MA, SR, CW, AW and EU. More than 250 in code.
reactProps: { value, label, icon?, group?, keywords?, disabled? }
label, hint, error, required, size, disabled, name
Same as Input. name adds a hidden input for forms.
You can change the texts for other languages.
ISO codes. preferred goes at the top, for example ['NL', 'BE', 'DE'].
Without a title the flag is decorative. Import from @rbbds/ui/flags.
behaviour: Click or arrow down opens the list. The chosen option is highlighted.
Typing filters by label and keywords, without accents (belgie finds België). Country select also searches by English name and ISO code.
Enter chooses, Escape closes without choosing, Tab chooses the highlighted option after a search.
If you close without a choice, the previous value comes back in the field.
a11y: APG combobox pattern with a listbox popup: role combobox, aria-expanded, aria-controls and aria-activedescendant.
Groups are role group with a label. The visual is decorative (aria-hidden), the label carries the name.
The chevron button is not in the tab order. The field itself opens the list.
Flags have a 1 px border, so light flags stay visible on white.
content: Placeholder as an action: "Choose a country".
Country names come from Intl. Do not write your own names.
do: Put the most chosen options at the top in their own group.
Add keywords for other names or codes.
Import flags from @rbbds/ui/flags, so they only load where you need them.
dont: A visual as the only difference between options.
Use it for 3 to 5 options: choose Radio or Select instead.
open: Multiple choice (multi select with tags) does not exist yet.
Loading options asynchronously does not exist yet.
Phone number with a country code (flag + prefix) does not exist yet.
